schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(255), email VARCHAR(255))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS logs (id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INT, action VARCHAR(255), timestamp DATETIME, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO users (username, email) SELECT CONCAT('user', n), CONCAT('user', n, '@example.com') FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO logs (user_id, action, timestamp) SELECT FLOOR(1 + (RAND() * {row_count})), 'login', NOW() FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
